import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
I=G['Demo pair 1 input']; O=G['Demo pair 1 output']
h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
diff=[(i,j,I[i][j],O[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if I[i][j]!=O[i][j]]
print(len(diff), set((a,b) for _,_,a,b in diff))
# check: changed cells = 4s orthogonally adjacent to a 9?
bad=[]
for i,j,a,b in diff:
    adj=[(i+di,j+dj) for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))]
    has9=any(0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and I[x][y]==9 for x,y in adj)
    if a==4 and has9 and b==2: pass
    else: bad.append((i,j,a,b))
print('diff not explained:',bad)
# cells adjacent to 9 but NOT changed
miss=[]
for i in range(h):
    for j in range(w):
        adj=[(i+di,j+dj) for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))]
        has9=any(0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and I[x][y]==9 for x,y in adj)
        if I[i][j]==4 and has9 and O[i][j]!=2:
            miss.append((i,j))
print('adj-to-9 not changed:',miss)
json.dump({'input':I,'output':O},open('/tmp/p1.json','w'))

def info(ii,oo,nm):
    n=len(ii); m=len(ii[0])
    c=Counter(x for r in ii for x in r); bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    L=[k for k in c if k!=bg][0]
    marks=[(i,j) for i in range(n) for j in range(m) if ii[i][j]==L]
    # cells filled in output beyond straight-gap rule
    st=transform6(ii)
    extra={(i,j) for i in range(n) for j in range(m) if oo[i][j]==2 and st[i][j]!=2}
    rows=[]
    for p,q in combinations(marks,2):
        if p[0]==q[0] or p[1]==q[1]: continue
        md=abs(p[0]-q[0])+abs(p[1]-q[1])
        if md>6: continue
        l,r=(p,q) if p[1]<q[1] else (q,p)
        cr,cc=r[0],l[1]
        v=abs(l[0]-cr); hh=abs(cc-r[1])
        path={(i,cc) for i in range(min(l[0],cr)+1,max(l[0],cr))}|{(cr,j) for j in range(min(cc,r[1])+1,max(cc,r[1]))}|{(cr,cc)}
        fillp=path&extra; blk=path-extra
        status='partial' if fillp and blk else ('full' if fillp else 'none')
        rows.append((nm,p,q,md,(v,hh),status,len(fillp),len(blk)))
    return rows
allr=[]
for nm,(ii,oo) in {'d1':(I,O),'d2':(I2p,O2p),'d3':(I3,O3)}.items():
    allr+=info(ii,oo,nm)
for row in allr: print(row)

def transformR2(grid):
    g=[list(r) for r in grid]; n=len(g); m=len(g[0])
    c=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r); bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    Lc=[k for k in c if k!=bg][0]
    M={(i,j) for i in range(n) for j in range(m) if grid[i][j]==Lc}
    g=transformR1s(grid)
    for p,q in combinations(sorted(M),2):
        if p[0]==q[0] or p[1]==q[1]: continue
        dr,dc=abs(p[0]-q[0]),abs(p[1]-q[1])
        if dr<=dc: continue
        l,r=(p,q) if p[1]<q[1] else (q,p)
        cr,cc=r[0],l[1]
        pl=perp(grid,M,l[0],l[1],'row')  # nearest mark in l's row
        pr=perp(grid,M,r[0],r[1],'col')  # nearest mark in r's col
        if not (pl>=dr and pr>=dr): continue
        for i in range(min(l[0],cr)+1, max(l[0],cr)+1):
            if g[i][cc]==bg: g[i][cc]=2
        for j in range(min(cc,r[1]), max(cc,r[1])):
            if g[cr][j]==bg: g[cr][j]=2
    return g

def Lpair_info(grid,Oo):
    n=len(grid); m=len(grid[0])
    c=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r); bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    Lc=[k for k in c if k!=bg][0]
    M={(i,j) for i in range(n) for j in range(m) if grid[i][j]==Lc}
    res=[]
    for p,q in combinations(sorted(M),2):
        if p[0]==q[0] or p[1]==q[1]: continue
        dr,dc=abs(p[0]-q[0]),abs(p[1]-q[1])
        if dr<=dc: continue
        l,r=(p,q) if p[1]<q[1] else (q,p)
        cr,cc=r[0],l[1]
        cells=[(i,cc) for i in range(min(l[0],cr),max(l[0],cr)+1)]+[(cr,j) for j in range(min(cc,r[1]),max(cc,r[1])+1)]
        cells=[(i,j) for (i,j) in cells if grid[i][j]==bg]
        ok=all(Oo[i][j]==2 for (i,j) in cells)
        pl=perp(grid,M,l[0],l[1],'row'); pr=perp(grid,M,r[0],r[1],'col')
        # also clearance of corner: nearest mark in corner row beyond arm, corner col beyond arm
        pc_r=perp(grid,M,cr,cc,'col'); pc_c=perp(grid,M,cr,cc,'row')
        res.append((dr,dc,pl,pr,pc_r,pc_c,ok))
    return res
for nm,(Ii,Oo) in {'d1':(I,O),'d2':(I2p,O2p),'d3':(I3,O3),'d4':(I4,O4)}.items():

def analyze(nm,Ii,Oo):
    n=len(Ii); m=len(Ii[0])
    c=Counter(x for r in Ii for x in r); bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    Lc=[k for k in c if k!=bg][0]
    M={(i,j) for i in range(n) for j in range(m) if Ii[i][j]==Lc}
    straight=transformR1s(Ii)
    unexpl={(i,j) for i in range(n) for j in range(m) if Oo[i][j]==2 and straight[i][j]!=2}
    info=[]
    for p,q in combinations(sorted(M),2):
        if p[0]==q[0] or p[1]==q[1]: continue
        dr,dc=abs(p[0]-q[0]),abs(p[1]-q[1])
        if dr<=dc: continue
        l,r=(p,q) if p[1]<q[1] else (q,p)
        cr,cc=r[0],l[1]
        cells=[(i,cc) for i in range(min(l[0],cr),max(l[0],cr)+1)]+[(cr,j) for j in range(min(cc,r[1]),max(cc,r[1])+1)]
        cells=[(i,j) for (i,j) in cells if Ii[i][j]==bg]
        covers=unexpl & set(cells)
        contra=[(i,j) for (i,j) in cells if Oo[i][j]!=2]
        pl=perp(Ii,M,l[0],l[1],'row'); pr=perp(Ii,M,r[0],r[1],'col')
        pcr=perp(Ii,M,cr,cc,'col'); pcc=perp(Ii,M,cr,cc,'row')
        rectempty=not any((i,j) in M for i in range(min(l[0],cr),max(l[0],cr)+1) for j in range(min(cc,r[1]),max(cc,r[1])+1) if (i,j) not in (p,q))
        info.append(dict(p=p,q=q,dr=dr,dc=dc,pl=pl,pr=pr,pcr=pcr,pcc=pcc,rect=rectempty,
                         covers=sorted(covers),contra=contra))
    return unexpl, info
for nm,(Ii,Oo) in {'d1':(I,O),'d2':(I2p,O2p),'d3':(I3,O3),'d4':(I4,O4)}.items():
    u,info=analyze(nm,Ii,Oo)
    print('==',nm,'unexplained:',sorted(u))
    cov=[d for d in info if d['covers']]
    for d in cov:
        print('  covers',d['covers'],'pair',d['p'],d['q'],'dr%d dc%d pl%d pr%d pcr%d pcc%d rect%d contra%d'%(
            d['dr'],d['dc'],d['pl'],d['pr'],d['pcr'],d['pcc'],d['rect'],len(d['contra'])))

def gap_data(Ii,Oo):
    n=len(Ii); m=len(Ii[0])
    cc=Counter(x for r_ in Ii for x in r_); bg=cc.most_common(1)[0][0]
    Lc=[k for k in cc if k!=bg][0]
    M={(i,j) for i in range(n) for j in range(m) if Ii[i][j]==Lc}
    ext=runs_extremal(M,n,m)
    rows_marks={i:sum(1 for j in range(m) if (i,j) in M) for i in range(n)}
    cols_marks={j:sum(1 for i in range(n) if (i,j) in M) for j in range(m)}
    def runlen(i,j,axis):
        if axis=='h':
            js=[jj for jj in range(m) if (i,jj) in M]
            a=js.index(j); b=a
            while a>0 and js[a-1]==js[a]-1: a-=1
            while b<len(js)-1 and js[b+1]==js[b]+1: b+=1
            return b-a+1
        else:
            iss=[ii for ii in range(n) if (ii,j) in M]
            a=iss.index(i); b=a
            while a>0 and iss[a-1]==iss[a]-1: a-=1
            while b<len(iss)-1 and iss[b+1]==iss[b]+1: b+=1
            return b-a+1
    out=[]
    for i in range(n):
        js=sorted(j for j in range(m) if (i,j) in M)
        for a,b in zip(js,js[1:]):
            ln=b-a-1
            if ln<1: continue
            filled=all(Oo[i][j]==2 for j in range(a+1,b))
            f=dict(orient='h',ln=ln,pda=perp(Ii,M,i,a,'row'),pdb=perp(Ii,M,i,b,'row'),
                   exta=ext[(i,a)][1],extb=ext[(i,b)][1],   # extremal in column run
                   rla=runlen(a,i,'v'),rlb=runlen(b,i,'v'),
                   nmark=rows_marks[i], other_exta=ext[(i,a)][0], other_extb=ext[(i,b)][0])
            out.append((f,filled))
    for j in range(m):
        iss=sorted(i for i in range(n) if (i,j) in M)
        for a,b in zip(iss,iss[1:]):
            ln=b-a-1

def cont_ext(M,n,m):
    ext={}
    for (i,j) in M:
        js=[jj for jj in range(m) if (i,jj) in M]
        a=js.index(j); b=a
        while a>0 and js[a-1]==js[a]-1: a-=1
        while b<len(js)-1 and js[b+1]==js[b]+1: b+=1
        h = (a==b) or j==js[0] or j==js[-1] or (j==js[a] and a==0) or (j==js[b] and b==len(js)-1)
        # extremal = singleton run or at boundary of full line? use: singleton or at line edge
        h = (b-a+1==1) or j==0 or j==m-1 or (j==js[0]) or (j==js[-1])
        iss=[ii for ii in range(n) if (ii,j) in M]
        a2=iss.index(i); b2=a2
        while a2>0 and iss[a2-1]==iss[a2]-1: a2-=1
        while b2<len(iss)-1 and iss[b2+1]==iss[b2]+1: b2+=1
        v = (b2-a2+1==1) or i==0 or i==n-1 or (i==iss[0]) or (i==iss[-1])
        ext[(i,j)]=(h,v)
    return ext

def transformR1sC(grid, use_ext=True):
    g=[list(r) for r in grid]; n=len(g); m=len(g[0])
    c=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r); bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    Lc=[k for k in c if k!=bg][0]
    M={(i,j) for i in range(n) for j in range(m) if grid[i][j]==Lc}
    ext=cont_ext(M,n,m)
    # horizontal gaps incl edges
    for i in range(n):
        js=sorted(j for j in range(m) if (i,j) in M)
        segs=[(0,js[0])]+list(zip(js,js[1:]))+[(js[-1],m-1)]
        for a,b in segs:
            if a==b: continue
            j1,j2=min(a,b),max(a,b); ln=j2-j1-1
            if ln<1: continue
            if a==0 or b==m-1:  # edge gap
                mk=(i,j2) if a==0 else (i,j1)
                ok = ext[mk][1] and perp(grid,M,mk[0],mk[1],'row')>ln
            else:
                ok = max(perp(grid,M,i,j1,'row'),perp(grid,M,i,j2,'row'))>ln
                if use_ext: ok = ok and ext[(i,j1)][1] and ext[(i,j2)][1]
            if ok:
                for j in range(j1+1,j2):
                    if g[i][j]==bg: g[i][j]=2
    for j in range(m):
        iss=sorted(i for i in range(n) if (i,j) in M)
        segs=[(0,iss[0])]+list(zip(iss,iss[1:]))+[(iss[-1],n-1)]
        for a,b in segs:
            if a==b: continue
            i1,i2=min(a,b),max(a,b); ln=i2-i1-1
            if ln<1: continue
            if a==0 or b==n-1:
                mk=(i2,j) if a==0 else (i1,j)
                ok = ext[mk][0] and perp(grid,M,mk[0],mk[1],'col')>ln
            else:
                ok = max(perp(grid,M,i1,j,'col'),perp(grid,M,i2,j,'col'))>ln

            if ok:
                for i in range(i1+1,i2):
                    if g[i][j]==bg: g[i][j]=2
    return g

def runs_of(line_vals):
    # returns list of (start,end) contiguous runs of marks
    runs=[]; s=None
    for i_,v in enumerate(line_vals):
        if v!=0:
            if s is None: s=i_
        else:
            if s is not None: runs.append((s,i_-1)); s=None
    if s is not None: runs.append((s,len(line_vals)-1))
    return runs

def analyze_gaps(Ii, Oo):
    n,m = Ii.shape
    bg = np.bincount(Ii.flatten()).argmax()
    lc = [c for c in np.unique(Ii) if c!=bg and c!=2]
    line = lc[0]
    M = (Ii==line)
    out = []
    # horizontal gaps (in each row, between mark cells; also edge gaps)
    for axis in ['row','col']:
        N = n if axis=='row' else m
        for a_ in range(N):
            vals = M[a_] if axis=='row' else M[:,a_]
            rr = runs_of(vals)
            # interior gaps between consecutive runs
            for k_ in range(len(rr)-1):
                e1 = rr[k_][1]; s2 = rr[k_+1][0]
                g = list(range(e1+1, s2))
                out.append(dict(axis=axis, line=a_, cells=g, gtype='interior',
                                eA=(a_, e1) if axis=='row' else (e1, a_),
                                eB=(a_, s2) if axis=='row' else (s2, a_)))
            # edge gaps
            if len(rr)>=1:
                for side,e_ in [('lead', rr[-1][1]), ('lag', rr[0][0])]:
                    if side=='lead': g=list(range(e_+1, N))
                    else: g=list(range(0, e_))
                    if g: out.append(dict(axis=axis, line=a_, cells=g, gtype='edge',
                                eA=(a_,e_) if axis=='row' else (e_,a_), eB=None))
    return M, bg, line, out

def gap_label_and_feats(Ii, Oo, ginfo):
    n,m = Ii.shape
    M = (Ii == [c for c in np.unique(Ii) if c not in (np.bincount(Ii.flatten()).argmax(),2)][0])
    filled = any(Oo[c_] == 2 for c_ in ginfo['cells'])
    res=[]
    for c_ in ginfo['cells']:
        r_,c__ = c_
        res.append(int(Oo[r_,c__]==2))
    return filled, res

def feats_for_gap(M, g, n, m):
    axis=g['axis']; line=g['line']; cells=g['cells']; ln=len(cells)
    f=dict(axis=axis, ln=ln, gtype=g['gtype'])
    def perp_info(pos, which):
        # pos=(r,c); which: perpendicular line of marks M
        r_,c_=pos
        if axis=='row': pv = M[:,c_]   # same column
        else: pv = M[r_,:]
        # endpoint pos is a mark; clearance to nearest other mark along perpendicular
        idx_ = r_ if axis=='row' else c_
        others=[i_ for i_,v in enumerate(pv) if v and i_!=idx_]
        pd_ = min((abs(i_-idx_) for i_ in others), default=10**6)
        # contiguous run of this mark in perpendicular line
        rr = runs_of(pv)
        myrun = [x for x in rr if x[0]<=idx_<=x[1]][0]
        rlen = myrun[1]-myrun[0]+1
        ext = (idx_==myrun[0] or idx_==myrun[1]) or rlen==1
        # number of other runs
        nruns = len(rr)
        return pd_, rlen, int(ext), nruns
    f['pdA'],f['rlA'],f['extA'],f['nrunA'] = perp_info(g['eA'],'A')
    if g['eB']:
        f['pdB'],f['rlB'],f['extB'],f['nrunB'] = perp_info(g['eB'],'B')
    else:
        f['pdB'],f['rlB'],f['extB'],f['nrunB']=None,None,None,None
    return f

Index 12 out of bounds for axis 0 size 12: r_=12. So a cell like (12, x) — from a col gap where cells=(r_,a_) r_ in range... e1+1..s2 where e1,s2 are row indices < n=12. Hmm r_ max 11. Unless axis mixup in feats_for_gap perp_info? No, error is in cells_res. Wait — for axis='col', cells=[(r_,a_)]: r_ from range(e1+1,s2) fine.

Oh! analyze_gaps2 was redefined but I'm iterating D.items() — the old `gs` from... no, fresh call. Hmm, actually the issue: `M=(Ii==lc[0])` fine.

Wait — maybe the issue is that my loop uses variable shadowing: `for (r_,c_) in g['cells']` — g['cells'] entries... for edge 'lead' axis row: cells=[(a_,c_) for c_ in range(e_+1,N)] — c_ up to N-1=m-1, a_ row idx fine. Hmm.

Let me debug: which gap triggers it.

def analyze_gaps2(Ii, Oo=None):
    n,m = Ii.shape
    bg = int(np.bincount(Ii.flatten()).argmax())
    lc = [int(c) for c in np.unique(Ii) if c!=bg and c!=2]
    line = lc[0]
    M = (Ii==line)
    out = []
    for axis in ['row','col']:
        nline, along = (n, m) if axis=='row' else (m, n)
        for a_ in range(nline):
            vals = M[a_] if axis=='row' else M[:,a_]
            rr = runs_of(vals)
            for k_ in range(len(rr)-1):
                e1 = rr[k_][1]; s2 = rr[k_+1][0]
                if axis=='row':
                    cells=[(a_,c_) for c_ in range(e1+1,s2)]; eA=(a_,e1); eB=(a_,s2)
                else:
                    cells=[(r_,a_) for r_ in range(e1+1,s2)]; eA=(e1,a_); eB=(s2,a_)
                out.append(dict(axis=axis, line=a_, cells=cells, gtype='interior', eA=eA, eB=eB))
            if len(rr)>=1:
                # trailing edge gap (after last run)
                e_=rr[-1][1]
                if axis=='row': cells=[(a_,c_) for c_ in range(e_+1,along)]; eA=(a_,e_); eB=None
                else: cells=[(r_,a_) for r_ in range(e_+1,along)]; eA=(e_,a_); eB=None
                if cells: out.append(dict(axis=axis, line=a_, cells=cells, gtype='edge', eA=eA, eB=eB, side='tail'))
                # leading edge gap (before first run)
                e_=rr[0][0]
                if axis=='row': cells=[(a_,c_) for c_ in range(0,e_)]; eA=(a_,e_); eB=None
                else: cells=[(r_,a_) for r_ in range(0,e_)]; eA=(e_,a_); eB=None
                if cells: out.append(dict(axis=axis, line=a_, cells=cells, gtype='edge', eA=eA, eB=eB, side='lead'))
    return M, bg, line, out

def feats3(Ii, r, c):
    n,m=Ii.shape
    bg=int(np.bincount(Ii.flatten()).argmax())
    M=(Ii!=bg)&(Ii!=2)
    row=M[r]; col=M[:,c]
    def near(v,i,step,lim):
        k=i+step
        while 0<=k<lim and not v[k]: k+=step
        return k if 0<=k<lim else None
    nL,nR,nU,nD = near(row,c,-1,m), near(row,c,1,m), near(col,r,-1,n), near(col,r,1,n)
    def runlen_perp(rr,cc, axis):
        # length of run containing (rr,cc) along given axis ('row' or 'col')
        if axis=='col':
            a=rr
            while a>0 and M[a-1,cc]: a-=1
            b=rr
            while b<n-1 and M[b+1,cc]: b+=1
        else:
            a=cc
            while a>0 and M[rr,a-1]: a-=1
            b=cc
            while b<m-1 and M[rr,b+1]: b+=1
        return b-a+1
    f={}
    for nm_,kk in [('L',nL),('R',nR),('U',nU),('D',nD)]:
        f['d'+nm_] = INF if kk is None else abs(kk-(r if nm_ in 'UD' else c))
        f['pd'+nm_] = 0 if kk is None else runlen_perp(*((kk,c) if nm_ in 'UD' else (r,kk)), 'col' if nm_ in 'LR' else 'row')
    f['rowHas']=int(row.any()); f['colHas']=int(col.any())
    f['ri']=int(nL is not None and nR is not None)
    f['ci']=int(nU is not None and nD is not None)
    # extremality: nearest mark's perp run length ==1
    for nm_ in ['L','R','U','D']:
        f['ex'+nm_]=int(f['pd'+nm_]==1)
    return f

def rule_union(Ii_):
    n_,m_=Ii_.shape
    bg_=int(np.bincount(Ii_.flatten()).argmax())
    M_=(Ii_!=bg_)&(Ii_!=2)
    rows_with=M_.any(1); cols_with=M_.any(0)
    minr,maxr=np.where(rows_with)[0][[0,-1]]
    minc,maxc=np.where(cols_with)[0][[0,-1]]
    pred=np.zeros((n_,m_),bool)
    # border rule
    for r_ in range(n_):
        for c_ in range(m_):
            if Ii_[r_,c_]==bg_ and (r_ in (minr,maxr) and minc<=c_<=maxc or c_ in (minc,maxc) and minr<=r_<=maxr):
                pred[r_,c_]=True
    # interior gap rule: both endpoints' perpendicular runs are singletons
    def run_len_v(rr,cc):
        a=rr
        while a>0 and M_[a-1,cc]: a-=1
        b=rr
        while b<n_-1 and M_[b+1,cc]: b+=1
        return b-a+1
    def run_len_h(rr,cc):
        a=cc
        while a>0 and M_[rr,a-1]: a-=1
        b=cc
        while b<m_-1 and M_[rr,b+1]: b+=1
        return b-cc+1
    # row gaps
    for r_ in range(n_):
        c_=0
        while c_<m_:
            if M_[r_,c_]:
                c_+=1; continue
            a=c_
            while c_<m_ and not M_[r_,c_]: c_+=1
            b=c_-1
            if a>0 and b<m_-1:  # interior
                if run_len_v(r_,a-1)==1 and run_len_v(r_,b+1)==1:
                    for cc in range(a,b+1): pred[r_,cc]=True
    for c_ in range(m_):
        r_=0
        while r_<n_:
            if M_[r_,c_]:
                r_+=1; continue
            a=r_
            while r_<n_ and not M_[r_,c_]: r_+=1
            b=r_-1
            if a>0 and b<n_-1:
                if run_len_h(a-1,c_)==1 and run_len_h(b+1,c_)==1:
                    for rr in range(a,b+1): pred[rr,c_]=True
    return pred

def rule_v3(Ii_):
    n_,m_=Ii_.shape
    bg_=int(np.bincount(Ii_.flatten()).argmax())
    M_=(Ii_!=bg_)&(Ii_!=2)
    pred=np.zeros((n_,m_),bool)
    rows_with=np.where(M_.any(1))[0]; cols_with=np.where(M_.any(0))[0]
    minr,maxr=rows_with[0],rows_with[-1]; minc,maxc=cols_with[0],cols_with[-1]
    for r_ in range(n_):
        for c_ in range(m_):
            if Ii_[r_,c_]!=bg_: continue
            if (r_ in (minr,maxr) and minc<=c_<=maxc) or (c_ in (minc,maxc) and minr<=r_<=maxr):
                pred[r_,c_]=True; continue
            # strictly between two opposite marks
            if c_>0 and c_<m_-1 and M_[r_,c_-1] and M_[r_,c_+1]: pred[r_,c_]=True
            elif r_>0 and r_<n_-1 and M_[r_-1,c_] and M_[r_+1,c_]: pred[r_,c_]=True
    return pred

for nm in sorted(D):
    Ii_,Oo_=D[nm]
    pred=rule_v3(Ii_)
    exp=(Oo_==2)
    mis=[(r_,c_,'extra' if pred[r_,c_] else 'miss') for r_ in range(Ii_.shape[0]) for c_ in range(Ii_.shape[1]) if pred[r_,c_]!=exp[r_,c_]]

for nm in sorted(D):
    Ii_,Oo_=D[nm]
    n_,m_=Ii_.shape
    bg_=int(np.bincount(Ii_.flatten()).argmax())
    M_=(Ii_!=bg_)&(Ii_!=2)
    exp=(Oo_==2)
    rw=np.where(M_.any(1))[0]; cw=np.where(M_.any(0))[0]
    minr,maxr=rw[0],rw[-1]; minc,maxc=cw[0],cw[-1]
    def run_v(rr,cc):
        a=rr
        while a>0 and M_[a-1,cc]: a-=1
        b=rr
        while b<n_-1 and M_[b+1,cc]: b+=1
        return b-rr+1
    def run_h2(rr,cc):
        a=cc
        while a>0 and M_[rr,a-1]: a-=1
        b=cc
        while b<m_-1 and M_[rr,b+1]: b+=1
        return b-cc+1
    # row gaps
    for r_ in range(n_):

        while c_<m_:

    # Complete dashed borders of stacked rectangles: fill bg cells on each
